subject: Clarify role-grade and offer framing for final candidates
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Two final candidates — quick alignment on title (L5 manager vs senior IC)

Team —

We're at the final stage with two candidates for the Platform Integrations role at Greenleaf. I need a clear leveling call so we can finalize offer language and comp. TL;DR: both candidates passed interviews, but interviewers disagreed on scope (people mgmt vs IC scale). We need to decide whether to present as an L5 Manager or L5 Senior IC (and whether either should be escalated to L6/Staff).

Candidate A — Cassandra Li (external recruiter: Amit Shah). Strong systems design, led a small cross-functional team (3 ICs) for last project but no formal P&L ownership. Interview panel split 3:1 in favor of manager because of stakeholder handling and roadmap decisions.

Candidate B — Michael Ortega. Deep technical ownership, designed infra components used org-wide. Panel split 2:2 for senior IC vs manager.

Attachments: Cassandra_Li_Resume.pdf, leveling_rubric_Q2_2026.xlsx, offer_memo_draft_v1.docx (draft ranges).

Asks:
- Can we choose the official title/level to put into the offer today? (Need to send by EOD 6/9 to meet recruiter deadlines.)
- If manager, do we route to HC for manager headcount (vs IC)?
- If manager, recommended comp range adjustments (I put baseline $165–185k base + 0.20%–0.30% equity in the draft).

Quick context — Greenleaf expects a manager hire framed as L5 manager. They requested a manager-level POC for roadmap syncs. However, for internal leveling consistency we must avoid over-indexing on external expectations.

Please reply inline. If I don't hear back by 12:00pm PT I'll escalate to Sean for signoff.

—Marissa
Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0139

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Two final candidates — quick alignment on title (L5 manager vs senior IC)

Marissa —

Thanks for the note and for pulling the docs together. I reviewed Cassandra's resume and the rubric. My read: Cassandra should be presented as L5 Manager. Rationale:
- She has demonstrable cross-team coordination and has been the de-facto people lead on recent initiatives (even if not on org chart).
- Interview feedback shows strong stakeholder management and prioritization — skills we want in a manager at L5.
- Greenleaf's ask for a manager POC is operationally relevant; hiring as a manager reduces churn risk.

That said, the hire should have manager expectations in the offer (1:1s, hiring support, performance reviews) and we should include a manager onboarding success metric at 3 months. If we brand as manager at L5, base comp should be toward the top of your draft band ($180–185k) and equity at 0.25%–0.30% to be competitive.

For Michael Ortega, I lean senior IC (L5) unless Michael indicates he wants to run a team. His technical depth suggests growth toward Staff, but not immediate Staff.

I'll approve manager HC routing for Cassandra — Lauren, can you confirm HC availability (we have 1 open manager HC in Platform Integrations pool)?

-Jonas
VP, Product Engineering
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Cassandra Li <cass.li@gmail.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Two final candidates — quick alignment on title (L5 manager vs senior IC)

Hi Marissa / Sean —

Thanks for the update and for moving this along. I wanted to clarify a couple of points before the offer goes out:

1) Title framing — I'm excited about people leadership, but I want the role to reflect the responsibilities. If presented as Manager, will performance goals and expectations be outlined clearly in the offer?

2) Compensation — can you confirm whether the base is guaranteed at the higher band and how equity vests?

I don't want to re-open the interview loop, just want to make sure the expectations and comp match. Happy to sign once those pieces are confirmed.

Thanks,
Cassandra Li
Lead Integration Engineer (candidate)
cass.li@gmail.com
Cell: 415-555-0199

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, legal_corp <legal@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Two final candidates — quick alignment on title (L5 manager vs senior IC)

Marissa / Lauren —

Thanks for the quick thread. Decision and next steps below.

Decision: Offer Cassandra Li as L5 Manager (Platform Integrations). Rationale: strong stakeholder & cross-functional ownership; aligns with Greenleaf requirements and Jonas' recommendation. We will not escalate to L6/Staff at this time.

Offer details to include (please mirror in the offer memo and present to candidate):
- Title: L5 Manager, Platform Integrations
- Base: $182,000 (final)
- Target comp (total cash): $200k–205k (base + performance bonus)
- Equity: 0.27% (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
- Manager expectations: 1 direct report by Q4 if performance metrics met; 3-month onboarding success metric (designated in offer memo).

Actions: 
- Marissa: finalize offer memo and send to Cassandra by EOD 6/10. Use the top of the band and include the manager success metric. Attach final JD and 3-month metrics.
- Lauren: confirm headcount routing to HC (mark manager bucket) and record HC change (Jira HR-842).
- Legal: please do a quick review of the offer_memo_draft_v1.docx — CC'd legal for a 2-hour turn.

One caveat — if the candidate pushes strongly for Staff/L6 or materially higher comp once presented, come back to me before increasing bands.

I'll mark this approved for payroll & comp.

- Sean
VP, Engineering Operations
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
